weather_report:
In the small hours, Subiaco is hushed; streetlights glaze the footpaths and a thicker ceiling of cloud settles in. It’s mostly dry now, but the air feels primed, the kind that carries the scent of wet pavement before the first drop falls. The sun is still an idea more than a presence, so UV exposure is negligible for the moment.

Around dawn and into mid-morning, expect light rain that softens edges and dulls the day’s colors. The sky will be a smudged page, with limited clarity and only brief hints of brightness if the clouds fray. Sunshine will be scarce early and UV will stay low, though if the cover lifts later, spring light can sharpen quickly, so keep sunscreen in your pocket just in case. Dress in easy layers with a light waterproof shell and shoes happy to meet a puddle; carry a compact umbrella for slow, intermittent showers. It’s a good morning for a quiet coffee run, a gym session, or reading by a window while the rain sketches the glass; later, if the weather steadies, an unhurried errand loop or a visit to a gallery will suit the mood.
